raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE BOOTHBLOOM |LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER March 2024- Present | Bangalore
Lead a team of 3 developers in the end-to-end architecture and development of a responsive, large-scale web application from the ground up.
Built APIs using Java, Springboot, MySQL for scalable microservices. • Engineered a high-performance analytics dashboard using React, visualizing complex business metrics with various charts, graphs, and bar graphs. • Designed and built supporting REST APIs using Node.js and MongoDB to
handle asynchronous data, real-time updates, and user authentication ﬂows. • Mentored junior and mid-level developers, led code reviews, and established
best practices for UI development and API integration.
BAZAARVOICE |SOFTWARE ENGINEER December 2020- March 2024 | Bangalore
Led the design and maintenance of RESTful APIs using Java, Dropwizard, and Hibernate/JPA, managing public API exposure through Apigee Edge. • Engineered scalable, reusable, and test-covered React components for
enterprise-level UIs, including data tables, modals, and ﬁle upload modules. • Spearheaded the successful migration of 5 microservices from Java 8 to Java
17, including a major Dropwizard upgrade (to v2.0.0).
Optimized a critical notiﬁcation poller, leveraging AWS SES and S3, to increase throughput from 2 to 120 notiﬁcations per minute.
Conﬁgured Log4J and Kibana dashboards to monitor application logs, track performance, and troubleshoot production issues.
Integrated SonarQube and GitHub Actions to enforce code coverage checks, improving overall code quality and maintainability.
SABRE TRAVEL TECHNOLOGIES |ASSOCIATE SOFTWARE DEVELOPER September 2017- September 2019 | Bangalore
Developed a corporate travel application from scratch as a full-stack developer, using Spring Boot, Hibernate, and React.
Owned the end-to-end design of multiple features, from MySQL/MariaDB database schema design and JPA entity creation to dynamic frontend implementation in React.
Wrote complex, optimized SQL queries to reduce server load by performing data manipulation directly within the database.
Built and deployed microservices on AWS EC2 instances and managed dependencies and builds using Maven.
Utilized Java’s asynchronous APIs for parallel programming to optimize backend request handling and performance.
